Fictional training material. This is not an RBI or SEBI document.
1. A deposit rate change requires 30 days notice.
2. Notice must be delivered by registered email.

Fictional training material. This is not an RBI or SEBI document.
1. KYC records must be retained for 5 years.
2. Video identification requires two reviewers.

Fictional training material. This is not an RBI or SEBI document.
1. The lending disclosure must show the annual percentage rate.
2. Borrowers receive a 7 day cooling period.

Fictional training material. This is not an RBI or SEBI document.
1. Payment incidents must be reported within 6 hours.
2. Payment logs must be retained for 2 years.

Fictional training material. This is not an RBI or SEBI document.
1. Brokers must reconcile client balances every business day.
2. Reconciliation exceptions must be resolved within 3 days.

Fictional training material. This is not an RBI or SEBI document.
1. Fund expense reports must be published every quarter.
2. Fund redemption notices require 4 business days.

Fictional training material. This is not an RBI or SEBI document.
1. Listed entities must file reports within 45 days.
2. The report must include a risk register.

Fictional training material. This is not an RBI or SEBI document.
1. Investor complaints must be acknowledged within 2 days.
2. Complaint resolution must finish within 21 days.

Fictional training material. This is not an RBI or SEBI document.
1. Surveillance alerts must be reviewed within 1 day.
2. The review requires approval by a supervisor.

Fictional training material. This is not an RBI or SEBI document.
1. The deposit rate notice period is now 45 days.
2. This amendment replaces section 1 of FRA/2025/01.
